##### Project general facts

Maryam Gate Residences is a thoughtfully designed residential development comprising six low-rise buildings that enhance the overall Maryam Island masterplan. The project offers an intimate living environment with easy access to the island’s retail boulevard, landscaped gardens, parks, and beachfront. Its architecture reflects a contemporary Arabic design language, combining clean modern lines with subtle traditional influences to create a warm and welcoming coastal community.

Naseem Residences, positioned at the forefront of Maryam Gate Residences, offers uninterrupted views of the Sharjah skyline and Al Khan Lagoon. The elegantly designed seven-storey building comprises 58 units, including one to four-bedroom apartments and three-bedroom townhouses. Residents benefit from a range of shared amenities, including a community gym, multi-function room, swimming pools, children’s play areas, and landscaped parks with dedicated walking and jogging paths, all designed to support an active and balanced lifestyle.

The interiors feature modern finishing with high-quality materials, ensuring durability and a refined aesthetic throughout the living spaces. The kitchens are fully equipped with appliances, combining practicality with contemporary design. The units are delivered unfurnished, providing residents with the flexibility to personalize their homes according to their own style and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Maryam Island is located in downtown Sharjah overlooking the Arabian Sea. It provides easy access to Sharjah and the neighbouring Emirates of Dubai, Ajman, and Umm Al Quwain via the Al Taawun and Al Ittihad Roads.  
  
Set to take the tourism industry of Sharjah by storm, Maryam Island promises to be the ultimate leisure and lifestyle destination with a range of alluring amenities and unique gastronomical offerings.  
  
Combined with the utmost privacy, the serene residential spaces offer visitors, tenants, owners, and guests the experience of a lifetime, with a relaxing promenade and a wealth of upscale amenities.
